description: This file contains React components related to data visualization and UI elements for analytics, including formatting functions, summary cards, mini bar charts, and CSV download links.

methods.name: cx
methods.description: Utility function to concatenate CSS class names, filtering out falsy values.

methods.name: formatNumber
methods.description: Formats a number with locale-specific grouping, returns '—' for null/undefined/NaN.

methods.name: formatPercent
methods.description: Formats a number as a percentage with specified decimal digits, returns '—' for invalid inputs.

methods.name: SummaryCards
methods.description: React component displaying a grid of summary items with responsive styling.

methods.name: MiniBarChart
methods.description: React component rendering a lightweight, inline bar chart with hover tooltip.

methods.name: CsvDownloadLink
methods.description: React component providing a styled link to download CSV files, with disabled state support.
